roles.name: Builder
roles.about: The owner. Approves scenarios, reviews the flow, signs off the gate.

roles.name: Agent
roles.about: An AI agent. Writes drafts of record files. Never approves or signs off.

roles.name: CI
roles.about: A headless run in a pipeline. Runs checks only.

roles.name: rehearse
roles.about: The tool itself. Validates, simulates, detects stale content.

stories.want: to create an EPIC record with one command
stories.soThat: agents and I start from a valid, empty structure

acceptance.given: a repo with no EPIC named 2026-11-05-demo
acceptance.then: docs/epics/2026-11-05-demo/ has brainstorm.md, prd.yaml, entities.yaml, flow.yaml, corrections.md and an empty scenarios/ folder, and validate passes (git does not keep the empty folder; validate accepts a missing scenarios/)

acceptance.given: the EPIC 2026-11-05-demo exists
acceptance.when: the builder runs the same command again
acceptance.then: the command fails, names the folder, and changes no file

stories.want: to know exactly what is wrong in a record draft
stories.soThat: I can fix my draft without a human

acceptance.given: flow.yaml has a box with no `outputs`
acceptance.then: exit code 1, and the error names flow.yaml, the box path, and the missing field

acceptance.given: a box points to story S9 and prd.yaml has no S9
acceptance.then: exit code 1, and the error names the box path and S9

acceptance.given: a scenario step names a box path that does not exist
acceptance.then: exit code 1, and the error names the scenario, the step and the path

stories.want: to simulate the EPIC and get a list of design errors
stories.soThat: I find errors before agents build anything

acceptance.given: box a outputs {orderId:string} and the next box b needs {orderId:number}
acceptance.then: the report has a contract error that names a → b and the field orderId

acceptance.given: a decision box has a "no" branch that no approved scenario reaches
acceptance.then: the report has a coverage error for that branch

acceptance.given: Order allows draft → paid only, and a scenario changes Order from draft to shipped
acceptance.then: the report has a lifecycle error that names the scenario, the box and the transition

acceptance.given: the end state of a scenario differs from an acceptance criterion of its story
acceptance.then: the report has an acceptance error that names the criterion ID

acceptance.given: the same record
acceptance.then: the two reports are byte-identical

stories.want: to see the flow as swimlanes and drill into boxes
stories.soThat: I understand who does what, and each hand-off between roles

acceptance.given: flow.yaml with lanes builder and system
acceptance.then: the panel shows two lanes, and each box is in the lane of its role

acceptance.given: a box with children
acceptance.then: the panel shows the nested diagram and a breadcrumb back to the parent

acceptance.given: an EPIC with stories S1 and S2 that both use box validate
acceptance.then: the big picture shows every role, the main processes in flow order, and one line per story through its processes; validate is marked shared by S1 and S2 (D42)

acceptance.given: a story with a box that writes Story.status:draft->signed
acceptance.then: the view shows WHAT (the story and its criteria), HOW (a swimlane of only its boxes, in order) and OUTPUT (Story.status draft → signed), then its scenarios (D42)

acceptance.given: `rehearse serve` runs
acceptance.when: the builder opens its URL in a browser
acceptance.then: the browser shows the same UI full screen

stories.want: to play a scenario step by step
stories.soThat: I see the data move through the boxes and the roles

acceptance.given: an approved scenario with 3 steps
acceptance.when: the builder plays it and moves to step 2
acceptance.then: the panel highlights the box of step 2 and shows its input, output and state change

stories.want: to approve the scenarios that agents drafted
stories.soThat: only scenarios I trust count as evidence

acceptance.given: a draft scenario
acceptance.then: the scenario records approvedBy, approvedAt and a content hash

acceptance.given: an agent has CLI access only
acceptance.when: the agent lists the CLI commands
acceptance.then: no command approves a scenario or signs off the gate, and each scenario stays a draft

acceptance.given: an approved scenario
acceptance.then: the scenario becomes stale and the simulator ignores it as evidence

stories.want: to see who may change which data, as a use case diagram
stories.soThat: I find a role that can change data it must not change

acceptance.given: a box in the buyer lane writes Order.status
acceptance.when: the builder opens the use case diagram
acceptance.then: actor buyer links to the use case of that box, the use case is tagged "writes Order.status", and it links to the box (D42)

stories.want: to see why the EPIC is ready or not ready
stories.soThat: I trust evidence, not a green badge

acceptance.given: requirement R2 has no story
acceptance.when: the builder opens the readiness view
acceptance.then: R2 shows "no proof", and the view gives the reason

acceptance.given: a box serves no requirement
acceptance.when: the builder opens the readiness view
acceptance.then: the box is in the list "no requirement"

acceptance.given: corrections.md has 3 caught-in-simulation and 1 caught-after-build
acceptance.when: the builder opens the readiness view
acceptance.then: the view shows 3 and 1

stories.want: to sign off the EPIC gate
stories.soThat: building starts only on a simulated, approved design

acceptance.given: one simulator error remains
acceptance.when: the builder tries to sign off
acceptance.then: the sign-off fails and lists the error

acceptance.given: all gate checks pass
acceptance.then: the record keeps who, when and a hash for each story

acceptance.given: a signed EPIC, and the builder changes the text of R4
acceptance.then: only the stories linked to R4 are stale and need a new sign-off

stories.want: to run validate, simulate and gate check without bb
stories.soThat: a PR cannot merge a broken or unsigned design

acceptance.given: a record with one simulator error
acceptance.then: exit code 1, and the JSON lists the error

acceptance.given: a generated record with 200 boxes and 100 scenarios
acceptance.then: each one finishes in less than 2 seconds
